svg.title: AuthGuard physical call architecture and three control zones
svg.desc: Green identifies AuthGuard control and SDK enforcement. Blue identifies interacting corporate identity systems, clients, a SCIM agent and business hosts. Orange identifies independent native product authentication and authorization without AuthGuard integration. Each Gateway, AuthN, AuthZ, Web, Redis and Shared IAM DB component type is drawn once; replica count is omitted. AuthN and AuthZ are stateless pods with external state. AuthN proof verification is grouped into credentials, IdP protocols and signing proofs, followed separately by identity projection/JIT/linking and token issuance. AuthZ checks CUD targets and read API admission/scope; SDKs compile read scopes into SQL WHERE and apply mutation guards. Separate typed arrows show discovered Principal/binding materialization, role policy persistence, local credential reads, JIT binding resolution, Principal status reads and SCIM writes. Step 14 Corporate changes (policies) means identity/group/admission facts via SCIM; department fine policy uses the management API. Native middleware IAM remains independent.
svg.metadata: AuthGuard architecture; 2026-11-15; Apache-2.0. Numbered physical calls, with explicit implementation gaps.
svg.text: Component types (replicas omitted). AuthN / AuthZ are stateless pods; state is held in IAM DB / Redis.
Canonical Principal (JIT / account linking as needed)
R: API gate + URN scope (row filtering in SDK)
Deploy: schema / issuer / keys / providers (2C / 2B independently)
9 Protected API: JWT signature / iss / aud / exp
Direct native I/O (no AuthN / AuthZ integration with AuthGuard)
Solid: runtime / dashed: management / dotted: state access. One Shared IAM DB with typed reader/writer arrows.
Executes allow/deny at Gateway or resource entry.
Evaluates API policy and bounded resource scope.
Resolves/creates Principal and binding at verified login.
Planned: group admission / membership evaluation, durable policy revision / replica publication and scoped admin (see specification).
